phases.title: Fix toggleFavourite: add pendingIds tracking and revert-on-failure
phases.notes: Edit src/benchmark-frontend/src/context/FavouritesContext.tsx only. Do not modify FavouriteButton.tsx, FavouritesPage.tsx, or any other file.
